card.name: The word micro in microgram units
card.fires_on: The word "micro" when it is written out as the start of a unit such as microgram or microGray, usually right after a number or an opening bracket in dose text.

modes.label: After a number
modes.description: "micro" follows a quantity and begins "micrograms" in a dose or concentration.

modes.label: In a unit label or formula
modes.description: "micro" follows an opening bracket and begins a unit in a table heading or dose formula.

card.plain: It fires on the "micro" that begins unit names like micrograms or microGy/MBq.
